trends.empty: No rates for these nights yet

positioning.indexInfo: Your rate divided by the competitor median rate × 100. Below 100 is cheaper than the median, above 100 is more expensive.
positioning.emptyOwn: Your hotel isn't on the watchlist yet
positioning.signLegend: (+) competitors more expensive than you / (−) cheaper. “Competitor median vs you” compares the competitor median with your rate on the same night; the rate index is the other way round (your rate ÷ median × 100).

heatmap.title: Rate heatmap
heatmap.info: Lowest advertised rate per hotel per night, always with a unit: k = thousand VND, M = million VND (1.3M = ₫1,300,000). The darker the cell, the higher the rate compared with the competitor median that night.
heatmap.note: k = thousand dong, tr = million dong. Lightest: 15%+ below the comp median; light: 5–15% below; middle: within ±5%; dark: 5–15% above; darkest: 15%+ above. Yellow ring “≥2n”: sold only for 2+ nights (restricted, not sold out). Grey cell: data older than 48 hours. Pink dot: promotion running. A dot under the date marks a public holiday.
